summary: Iter 134: Pair-2 follow-on extensions (Restock Countdown + Waitlist Auto-Play) tested end-to-end on web + mobile. ALL flows PASS on both surfaces with full parity. Backend regression (test_iter134_restock_ext.py) 4/4 green: (a) GET /api/store/adv_fpk exposes resets_at and cmp_fpk_spin sold-out; (b) GET /api/me/notifications returns coupon_restock with payload.campaign_id='cmp_fpk_spin', payload.play_url='/play/cmp_fpk_spin', payload.play_route='/game/cmp_fpk_spin'; (c) GET /api/user/notifications/inbox returns the same as a merged non-sponsored row with target_url='/play/cmp_fpk_spin'; (d) POST /api/admin/waitlist/dispatch idempotent. WEB /store/adv_fpk: sold-out card store-game-cmp_fpk_spin shows store-game-cmp_fpk_spin-restock '🔔 Restocks in 18:20:28' and ticked to 18:20:26 after ~2s. Non-sold-out cards (cmp_fpk_scratch/quiz/mystery) do NOT render a restock line. WEB /notifications: found notification-inbox-row-notif_6b182c7ffceb45 titled '“FPK Spin & Save” just restocked 🎟️', href='/play/cmp_fpk_spin', data-sponsored='false' — clicking navigated to /play/cmp_fpk_spin ✅. MOBILE /store/adv_fpk (Expo web preview after demo-login-btn): store-game-cmp_fpk_spin-restock '🔔 Restocks in 18:19:33' -> 18:19:31 (tick verified). MOBILE /notifications (notif-inbox): notif-item-notif_6b182c7ffceb45 with '“FPK Spin & Save” just restocked 🎟️' text and game-controller icon — tap navigated router.push to /game/cmp_fpk_spin ✅. No new bugs. No parity issues. Same notif_id across surfaces confirms shared inbox.
critical_code_review_comments: StorePage.jsx + mobile/app/store/[id].tsx: fmtHMS is duplicated across web and mobile (identical body). Consider extracting to a shared util if you accumulate more time formatters — non-blocking.

StorePage.jsx: interval runs at 1000ms whenever the page is mounted; if user leaves the tab open for hours the countdown will (correctly) show 00:00:00 past midnight — no auto-refresh of /api/store data at that boundary. If desired, main agent could re-fetch when restockMs crosses 0 to hydrate the new day's remaining_today. Non-blocking for this iteration.

Notifications.jsx FullRow: for non-sponsored coupon_restock rows the click still opens in the same tab via <Link> (correct); no analytics fire on click (only sponsored rows POST /click). If product wants CTR on organic waitlist auto-play, add a fire-and-forget click ping. Non-blocking.
mobile notifications.tsx openNotif: relies on p.play_route ?? `/game/{campaign_id}` — payload confirmed to include play_route so the fallback is defensive. Good.

success_rate.frontend: web 100% (restock countdown ticks; non-soldout cards no restock; /notifications row href=/play/cmp_fpk_spin; click navigates); mobile 100% (restock countdown ticks; notif-item tap navigates to /game/cmp_fpk_spin)
